annotation.title_clean: Elements for a Legally Binding Instrument to Address the Challenges Posed by Autonomy in Weapon Systems
annotation.title_en: Elements for a Legally Binding Instrument to Address the Challenges Posed by Autonomy in Weapon Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Chile and Mexico (submission to the CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS)
annotation.venue: UN CCW GGE on Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Working paper by Chile and Mexico to the CCW GGE on LAWS proposing elements of a legally binding instrument on autonomy in weapon systems, combining prohibitions on uncontrollable or IHL-incompatible systems with positive obligations for meaningful human control, accountability and precautionary legal weapons reviews.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibit weapons with autonomous functions that cannot be controlled by humans or used in compliance with IHL
Prohibit systems whose effects cannot be understood, predicted and explained
Require human operators to set spatial/temporal limits, supervise, and be able to interrupt and deactivate systems
Ensure investigation, prosecution and individual responsibility for commanders and operators; avoid accountability gaps
Legal weapons reviews should apply a precautionary approach and deny authorization absent full certainty
